title: PGU-Decoder: Prior-Guided Unified Decoding for Industrial Road-Network Map Updating
abstract: arXiv:2611.23936v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Timely road-network map updates are essential to navigation and autonomous driving. Three key tasks are intra-intersection road network generation, merging/diverging detection, and drivable-area detection, covering topology, geometry, and attributes, respectively. Separate pipelines duplicate rule maintenance, quality assurance, and manual verification, increasing operational costs. We propose PGU-Decoder, a production-grade unified decoding framework for semantic prediction across these tasks. A Prior Query Module (PQM) constructs point-level prior queries from sampled locations on road-network geometries. Fixed reference points preserve positional priors throughout decoding, allowing the model to focus on surrounding context. Point-level representations are aggregated into instance-level representations, and a Relational Graph Attention Network (RGAT) captures inter-instance dependencies. Task-specific heads then generate predictions.

translated_title: PGU-Decoder：面向工业级路网地图更新的先验引导统一解码框架
translated_abstract: 及时的路网地图更新对导航和自动驾驶至关重要。其中三个关键任务分别是交叉口内部路网生成、合流/分流检测以及可行驶区域检测，分别覆盖拓扑、几何和属性三个维度。采用独立的流水线处理这些任务会导致规则维护、质量保证和人工验证的重复劳动，增加运营成本。我们提出PGU-Decoder，一个面向上述任务语义预测的生产级统一解码框架。其中，先验查询模块（PQM）从路网几何上采样的位置点构建点级先验查询；固定的参考点在整个解码过程中保留位置先验，使模型能够专注于周围的上下文信息；随后，点级表示被聚合为实例级表示，并由关系图注意力网络（RGAT）捕获实例间的依赖关系；最后由任务特定的预测头生成各项预测结果。
tldr: PGU-Decoder提出先验引导的统一解码框架，通过先验查询模块和关系图注意力网络，统一处理交叉口路网生成、合流/分流检测与可行驶区域检测三大任务，降低工业级路网地图更新的运营成本。
en_tdlr: PGU-Decoder proposes a prior-guided unified decoding framework that combines a Prior Query Module and a Relational Graph Attention Network to jointly handle intra-intersection road network generation, merging/diverging detection, and drivable-area detection, reducing operational costs for industrial road-network map updating.
